description.value: H Mart is a Korean-founded pan-Asian supermarket chain with a Victoria location inside a Douglas Street shopping complex. The store stocks a broad range of Asian groceries, fresh produce, and specialty ingredients not commonly found in mainstream Canadian supermarkets. For a touring cyclist, it is a reliable stop for resupply with a notably diverse selection of shelf-stable and fresh foods.
